interpretation: On REAL, unedited weights BSA_w8 = 0.565, far above the published 0.35 separator that Gaussian simulation predicts, so the absolute threshold FALSE-POSITIVES on an honest transformer. The within-checkpoint anisotropy null puts that honest value at z = 25.1, which means real networks carry genuinely shared bottom-subspace directions of their own -- the null does NOT explain them away. Both facts argue the statistic must be reported threshold-free (AUROC) and z-calibrated, never against an absolute cut.
